Privacy law management
with AI

05Legislative intelligence

Bill and law ingestion with AI.
Impact analysis for a specific enterprise.

Ingest bills and laws, extract structured provisions and assess their relevance to an enterprise’s products, jurisdictions and data practices. Connect legislative information to the business context needed for legal and operational review.

Experience in data, engineering & AI

A builder’s mindset.
An enterprise perspective.

My career has taken me through software engineering, cloud platforms, applied machine learning and financial data products. I bring that experience to Dataknobs: connecting business priorities with architecture, product decisions and delivery.

I care about making complex capabilities easier to use, giving teams control over their systems, and learning from how products perform in practice.

More of the work that shaped my approach

Earlier engineering and consulting work included enterprise systems and financial-services projects. In 2022–2023, I worked as CTO on supply-chain AI, including forecasting and demand sensing.

My broader experience includes data governance, privacy, cloud architecture across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, and applications of machine learning to areas such as streamflow forecasting.

I have also written on SQL Server and contributed work on machine learning for hydrology. See my professional profile for more background.
